monitor.header.empty: No bot is configured for this monitor yet. Each bot appears here as a chip once BOT_APIS lists it.
monitor.header.loading: Connecting to the bots. Each chip shows its spot, DVOL and data age after the first answer.
monitor.header.stale: No update from this bot in the last seconds. The figures shown are the last ones received; the monitor keeps asking.
monitor.header.error: The bot is not answering (OFFLINE). Nothing on this page updates for it until it answers again.

monitor.gex.empty: GEX not computed yet. The bot builds it every 60 s from mainnet open interest; new entries and repairs wait until then.
monitor.gex.loading: Waiting for the bot's first GEX snapshot. Regime, trend and gamma flip appear once it is built.
monitor.gex.stale: The last GEX snapshot is over 5 minutes old. New entries, top-ups and repairs wait; exits keep running.
monitor.gex.error: GEX could not be read from this bot. Regime and flip show as missing, never as a guess.

monitor.summary.empty: Nothing held and no trade yet. This card fills in after the bot's first entry or close.
monitor.summary.loading: Loading the summary: what the bot holds, its monthly income, the worst case now and its last action.
monitor.summary.stale: The bot stopped answering. The summary shown is from its last answer and is not refreshed.
monitor.summary.error: Summary unavailable: the bot did not answer. No numbers are shown rather than old or partial ones.

monitor.kpi.empty: No counts yet. Orders, closes and P&L are counted from the first decision the bot journals.
monitor.kpi.loading: Loading the counts from each bot's journal. They are restored when a bot restarts.
monitor.kpi.stale: At least one bot is not updating. Its counts are the last ones received.
monitor.kpi.error: The counts could not be read. Missing figures show as a dash, never as 0.

monitor.panel.account.empty: No account data yet. Deribit's equity and margin appear here after the bot's first account poll.
monitor.panel.account.loading: Loading the account summary the bots read from Deribit. Margin figures are Deribit's, not recomputed.
monitor.panel.account.stale: The account figures are older than the bot's poll interval. They are the last ones Deribit reported.
monitor.panel.account.error: Account not loaded: the bot could not read it. New entries wait while margin is unknown; exits keep running.

monitor.panel.positions.empty: No open strangle yet. A row appears once an entry order fills on a vacant slot.
monitor.panel.positions.loading: Loading the bots' open positions. Rows show each leg with its mark, P&L and Greeks.
monitor.panel.positions.stale: Positions from a bot that stopped updating. Marks and P&L are the last ones received.
monitor.panel.positions.error: Positions could not be read. The bot keeps managing them; this view shows nothing rather than a guess.

monitor.panel.held.empty: No missing leg. A row appears when a strangle is left with one leg and the bot holds its repair.
monitor.panel.held.loading: Loading the missing legs and the rule holding each repair.
monitor.panel.held.stale: The bot stopped updating. The holds shown are the last ones it reported.
monitor.panel.held.error: Missing legs could not be read. The bot's repair rules keep running without this view.

monitor.panel.others.empty: No position outside the bots. Any other position on the account appears here, since it uses margin.
monitor.panel.others.loading: Loading the account's other positions from Deribit.
monitor.panel.others.stale: The list is older than the bot's account poll. It shows the last positions Deribit reported.
monitor.panel.others.error: Other positions unavailable: the list could not be read. This is not the same as none.

monitor.panel.trades.empty: No trade yet. Opens and closes appear here from the first fill, with realised P&L from the first close.
monitor.panel.trades.loading: Loading the trade history from each bot's journal.
monitor.panel.trades.stale: A bot stopped updating. Its trades are listed up to its last answer.
monitor.panel.trades.error: The trade history could not be read. The journal on the bot is unchanged.

monitor.panel.activity.empty: No activity yet. Every order, fill, close, skip and margin change the bot journals appears here.
monitor.panel.activity.loading: Loading the bots' recent events from their journals.
monitor.panel.activity.stale: A bot stopped updating. The feed resumes from where it stopped once the bot answers.
monitor.panel.activity.error: Events could not be read. The bot keeps journaling them; they appear here once it answers.

monitor.panel.pnl.empty: No P&L history yet. The bot writes a point each report interval; the first point starts this chart.
monitor.panel.pnl.loading: Loading the stored P&L history for the selected range.
monitor.panel.pnl.stale: No new P&L point lately. The chart ends at the last point a bot reported.
monitor.panel.pnl.error: P&L history could not be read. Missing time is left blank, never filled in.

monitor.panel.pnl_coin.empty: No P&L history in coin yet. Each bot's chart starts at its first stored point.
monitor.panel.pnl_coin.loading: Loading each bot's P&L in its own coin.
monitor.panel.pnl_coin.stale: No new point lately. Each chart ends at the last point its bot reported.
monitor.panel.pnl_coin.error: P&L in coin could not be read for this bot. Missing time is left blank, never filled in.

monitor.panel.orders.empty: No working order. Entry and repair orders show here while they rest on Deribit, until filled or cancelled.
monitor.panel.orders.loading: Loading the orders the bots have resting on Deribit.
monitor.panel.orders.stale: A bot stopped updating. Its working orders are the last ones it reported.
monitor.panel.orders.error: Working orders could not be read. Unfilled orders are still cancelled by the bot after the fill timeout.
